Line 1. Taxable income. Line 56 of the return.
Line 2. If the amount from line 1 is $31,000 or less. Enter the amount from line 1.

Line 3. If the amount from line 1 is $31,000 or less. Base amount.
Line 3. If the amount from line 1 is more than $31,000, but not more than $67,000. Base amount.
Line 3. If the amount from line 1 is more than $67,000. Base amount.
Line 4. If the amount from line 1 is $31,000 or less. Line 2 minus line 3.
Line 4. If the amount from line 1 is more than $31,000, but not more than $67,000. Line 2 minus line 3.
Line 4. If the amount from line 1 is more than $67,000. Line 2 minus line 3.
Line 5. If the amount from line 1 is $31,000 or less. Rate.
Line 5. If the amount from line 1 is more than $31,000, but not more than $67,000. Rate.
Line 5. If the amount from line 1 is more than $67,000. Rate.
Line 6. If the amount from line 1 is $31,000 or less. Line 4 multiplied by line 5.
Line 6. If the amount from line 1 is more than $31,000, but not more than $67,000. Line 4 multiplied by line 5.
Line 6. If the amount from line 1 is more than $67,000. Line 4 multiplied by line 5.
Line 7. If the amount from line 1 is $31,000 or less. Tax on base amount.
Line 7. If the amount from line 1 is more than $31,000, but not more than $67,000. Tax on base amount.
Line 7. If the amount from line 1 is more than $67,000. Tax on base amount.
Line 8. If the amount from line 1 is $31,000 or less. Manitoba tax on taxable income. Line 6 plus line 7.
Line 8. If the amount from line 1 is more than $31,000, but not more than $67,000. Manitoba tax on taxable income. Line 6 plus line 7.
Line 8. If the amount from line 1 is more than $67,000. Manitoba tax on taxable income. Line 6 plus line 7.
Manitoba tax on taxable income. Line 1.

Line 9. Manitoba tax on taxable income. Line 1 multiplied by 17.4%.
Total donations and gifts. Line 17A of Schedule 11.
Total donations and gifts. On the first $200 or less.
Line 10. Total donations and gifts. On the first $200 or less multiplied by 10.8%.
Amount_Read_Only
Total donations and gifts. On the remainder.
Amount_Read_Only
Line 11. Total donations and gifts. On the remainder multiplied by 17.4%.
Line 12. Donations and gifts tax credit. Line 10 plus line 11.
Line 13. Enter the amount from line 8 or line 9 above.
Amount_Read_Only
Family tax benefit. $2,065 minus the product of 9% multiplied by line 50 of the return. If negative, enter 0.
Amount_Read_Only
Line 14. Family tax benefit. $2,065 minus the product of 9% multiplied by line 50 of the return. Multiply this product by 10.8%.
Line 15. Subtotal. Line 13 minus line 14. If negative, enter 0.
Line 16. Donations and gifts tax credit. Line 12.
Dividend tax credit. Line 24 of Schedule 8.
Amount_Read_Only
Line 17. Dividend tax credit. Line 24 of Schedule 8 multiplied by 29.0526%.
Dividend tax credit. Line 31 of Schedule 8.
Amount_Read_Only
Line 18. Dividend tax credit. Line 31 of Schedule 8 multiplied by 5.4411%.
Minimum tax carryover. Line 30 of Schedule 11.
Amount_Read_Only
Line 19. Minimum tax carryover. Line 30 of Schedule 11 multiplied by 50%.
Line 20. Total credits. Add lines 16 to 19. Instance 1.
Line 20. Total credits. Add lines 16 to 19. Instance 2.
Line 21. Subtotal. Line 15 minus line 20. If negative, enter 0.
Line 22. Manitoba additional tax for minimum tax purposes. Amount G from Chart 3 of Schedule 12.
Line 23. Subtotal. Line 21 plus line 22.
Line 24. Total Manitoba political contributions.
Line 25. Allowable political contribution tax credit. See instructions on next page.
Instructions
Line 26. Manitoba foreign tax credit. From Form T3 PFT, T3 Provincial or Territorial Foreign Tax Credit.
Line 27. Subtotal. Line 25 plus line 26. Instance 1.
Line 27. Subtotal. Line 25 plus line 26. Instance 2.
Line 28. Manitoba tax. Line 23 minus 27. If negative, enter 0. Enter this amount on line 82 of the return.
